whyItMatters: Code.eval_string evaluates strings as elixir code, so untrusted input reaching it becomes code injection.
actions: Replace Code.eval_string with pattern matching or Config-free data flow so untrusted input stays data, never code.
If evaluation must stay, isolate it in a sandbox without file, network, or credential access.
Re-run the scan and confirm no Code.eval_string call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no Code.eval_string reachable from untrusted input, and injection probes stay inert data.
